text:
Uma: Thanks for the live Q&A earlier. Leadership asked me to capture concrete launch windows, one-line owner statuses, and which items are absolute blockers vs scope we can cut. Paste a single-line update and tag MUST or CAN_DEFER.
Jared: API (Phase 1) target = start of Q3 (~4-6w). Owner: Jared. Status: legal SLA pending + pricing table. MUST: signed SLA & billing surface. CAN_DEFER: admin-only endpoints.
Lin: Infra note: we have a reproducer for a token-bucket + streaming interaction causing occasional stalls. Patch in PR, running CI. If green I can promote to staging tonight and run a 36h soak. Owner: Lin (Platform). Status: in-PR -> CI. CAN_DEFER if we gate with canary but prefer fix pre-Phase1.
Olga: Console (MVP) target = mid-Q3. Owner: Olga. Scope = admin flows, rollout UI, per-route model pins, basic dashboards. MUST: rollout UI and model pinning. CAN_DEFER: Optimize panels, full quantization controls, external APM link. Suggest dark-launch advanced widgets behind flags.
Jared: Structured output/tool-calls are in limited beta and will not block Phase 1. We'll widen canary coverage before final launch.
Lin: Small ask: can we postpone the APM connector to Q4 to reduce Console QA surface?
Uma: Leadership ok'd deferring noncritical external integrations if it helps hit the mid-Q3 console window.
FinanceBot: Reminder: pricing & meter-name signoff required 8 business days before Phase1 GA. Finance owner: @Marcus. MUST.
Olga: Optimize advisor timeline: public beta = late-Q3, GA = Q4. Owner: Olga + Research. Needs 3 production evals demonstrating cost delta; minimal UI to show estimated savings per recommendation for beta. MUST: infra quota for per-tenant batched evals. CAN_DEFER: advanced recommendation ordering and RBAC.
Jared: Runtime (Dedicated) note: we'll run a p99 validation canary after the staging patch is healthy. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 72h observation windows. Gate: p99 within acceptable multiple of baseline and no sustained OOMs. Owner: Eng-runtime. MUST.
Lin: Canary update: PR landed to staging at 09:40; running 36h soak. Initial repro rate down >85%. Will request canary rollout if soak stays green. :white_check_mark:
Uma: Action items I captured: 1) Jared -> chase Legal & Finance for SLA/pricing (ETA 7bd). 2) Lin -> post soak link and request canary if green. 3) Runtime -> schedule Dedicated p99 canary after canary go-ahead. 4) Olga -> publish Console MVP scope doc and mark deferrables. 5) Olga/Research -> open infra quota ticket for Optimize experiments.
DevOps-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap sync Fri 09:00 PT.
Lin: If soak fails we have a 48h hotfix plan; that would likely add ~1 week to Phase1 timing. I'll post slip updates in this thread.
Uma: Please keep this thread minimal — if a date slips post one line (e.g., "Lin: soak failed -> +3d"). I'll update the cross-team tracker after EOD. :thumbsup:
